inlines.v: ARTHRIT'IS, noun [Gr. from a joint. It seems to be of the same family as artus, a limb.] In a general sense, any painful disease of the joints; but more particularly, the gout, an hereditary, intermitting disease, usually affecting the small joints; sometimes the stomach.
